## Linked issue

## Change
Before/after, mechanism and non-goals.

## Evidence and checks
Candidate revision; GNU version; OS/architecture; actual commands/results.
Verification metrics: upstream script results, contract tests, skips/errors,
binary SHA-256/size and Homebrew installation result. Link CI artefacts.

## Diagram + journey
For structural changes, inline Mermaid followed by a short user journey.
Otherwise state why no structural or visible UI change occurred.

## Metrics and alerts created
Metrics created: none unless named CI verification measurements were added.
Alerts created: none because this local CLI has no running service or telemetry.
Describe any changes to CI failure reporting and why they matter.

## Risks / remaining
Separate implemented, tested, published and observed states. List platform
limitations, unrun checks, release/installation blockers and linked follow-ups.

## Agent reflection and knowledge saved
Journal path; struggles/lessons; source evidence; authorised Cognee dataset/key;
actual recall/write/retrieval status or pending-sync reason. Human-only changes
state that no agent session participated.
